questions.question: Use focus_lines with lines equal to dim and use highlight_trend with trend_type equal to United States in order to know What patterns can you observe in telecom services employment trends across North American countries from 2003 to 2024?

answer.value: Several key patterns emerge: 1) The United States has by far the highest employment (average 1,360.5K) but shows a significant declining trend (-41.1% from 1,772.2K to 1,044.7K), 2) Mexico is the only major country showing strong growth (+82.6% from 150.5K to 274.8K), 3) Most smaller countries show declining trends, with Grenada experiencing the steepest decline (-83.3%), 4) El Salvador is an exception among smaller countries, showing growth (+71.6%), 5) The gap between the US and other countries is narrowing as US employment decreases while Mexico grows.

key_insights: United States has highest employment but declining trend
El Salvador growing among smaller countries
Gap between US and others narrowing

reasoning.reasoning: Focus on United States and Mexico lines to compare trends
Highlight increasing trend to identify growing markets
